newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Yields lower to steady on latest Saudi t-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields lower to steady on latest Saudi t-bills.

text.p: Yields were lower to steady at this week's Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency offering of two billion riyals worth of one-month to one-year treasury bills, bankers in Saudi Arabia said on Tuesday.
They said the yield on 28-day bills was unchanged at 5.7384 percent and the rate on 91-day bills was also flat at 5.7936.

The yield on 182-day paper fell to 5.8551 percent from 5.8879 percent and the 364-day bills dropped to 5.9816 percent from 6.0860 percent. The bills were priced at 99.55566, 98.55664, 97.12500 and 94.29680 respectively.

One-month interbank deposit rates were quoted at 5-7/8, 3/4 percent, three months at 5-15/16, 13/16 percent, six months at six, 5-7/8 percent and one year were put at 6-1/8, six percent. -- Bahrain newsroom 973-524424
